description: Edit an image: resize, crop, rotate, convert format, compress, overlay text, flip, blur, sharpen, grayscale. Requires ImageMagick.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

format.description: Output format: png, jpg, webp, gif, bmp, tiff (convert).

input.description: Absolute path to the input image.

offsetX.description: Crop X offset from top-left. Default: 0.

offsetY.description: Crop Y offset from top-left. Default: 0.

position.description: Text position: north, south, center, northeast, etc. Default: south.

name: media_image_edit
